Read the cover note, table of contents, executive summary (pp. 4-6), section 4 key structural challenges (pp. 16-29, including the indicator table), section 5 on the 2022 policy guidance (pp. 30-34), Annex A (pp. 35-45), Annex B indicators (pp. 46-49), Annex C (p. 50) and Annex D (pp. 51-53); remaining pages scanned by keyword. No acquis chapter structure and no Chapter 2 material, so cluster and chapter are empty and all items are in scope on theme. Left out as outside the materiality test: the Public Revenue Office digital transformation and integrated IT tax system (PG 1 and measure 19, tax IT upgrades), IFMIS and the digitalisation of public financial management (back-office), the state aid management information system and registry (measure 14), the parafiscal charges web-portal (publishing online), the online business-to-business supplier portal and digital sales channels mentioned within FDI linkage and export policy, the electronic system for guarantees of origin in energy, the hybrid fund for green and digital start-ups, and stand-alone digital skills passages (the country report's call for a digital skills strategy and the survey on employees' digital skills). In the policy guidance table (page 32), the sentences on registered users and informational services restate page 22 and are not extracted again. Policy guidance scores are the Commission's PG scale, so eu_scale is left empty. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
